parsed.draft_response:
Hi team,

Thanks for the details. We can route this to our privacy/compliance contact for DPA review support.

To ensure the right responses (and avoid delays), could you please share:
1) The specific DPA document/version your legal team is reviewing (or a link/name).
2) Which subprocessors you want confirmed (names and/or any jurisdictions).
3) The intended retention period(s) your legal team is looking to validate, and for which data categories (e.g., EU customer records vs. support/ticket logs).
4) Your expectations for support logs regarding customer identifiers (e.g., whether identifiers may appear unredacted, and if there’s a preferred redaction/masking approach).
5) The privacy contact details you’d like us to route to (name/email or the correct alias/channel).

Once we have the above, we’ll escalate internally to the privacy team for review and respond with the applicable, agreed information.

Best regards,
Customer Support
promised_actions: Route the DPA clarification request to the privacy/compliance contact for review.
Request the minimum additional details needed to route accurately and respond without unnecessary back-and-forth.
safety_notes: Do not confirm subprocessors/retention/log behavior without internal privacy review.
Do not promise a timeline, specific outcome, or legal conclusion.
